tagline.en: NYU VisionX's Solaris — an interactive world model that generates video you can steer, including multi-agent scenes.
tagline.zh: NYU VisionX 出品的 Solaris——一个可交互的世界模型，能生成你可以操控的视频，包括多智能体场景。

en: Solaris is a world model from NYU's VisionX group. Rather than producing a fixed clip, it generates video as an interactive, controllable world — you can influence how the scene unfolds, and it supports multi-agent settings where several actors move at once.

The model is run inference-only in WorldFoundry, with its pretrained weights and evaluation data hosted on Hugging Face under nyu-visionx/solaris. Because it is built to be steered, it fits interactive generation and world-simulation experiments rather than one-shot text-to-video.
zh: Solaris 是 NYU VisionX 团队的世界模型。它不是产出一段固定片段，而是把视频当作一个可交互、可控的世界来生成——你可以影响场景如何演进，并且支持多个角色同时运动的多智能体设定。
在 WorldFoundry 中以推理模式运行，其预训练权重与评测数据托管在 Hugging Face 的 nyu-visionx/solaris 下。由于它天生面向操控，更适合交互式生成与世界模拟类实验，而非一次性的文生视频。

whenToUse.en: Reach for Solaris when you want an interactive, steerable world model rather than a one-shot video generator — especially for multi-agent scenes where you want to influence how the world evolves.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要的是一个可交互、可操控的世界模型，而不是一次性视频生成器时，选择 Solaris——尤其适合希望影响世界演进的多智能体场景。

notFor.en: Not the simplest path for plain text-to-video; it is built around interactive world simulation and needs its pretrained weights staged from Hugging Face first.
notFor.zh: 若只想做简单的文生视频，它并非最省事的选择；它围绕交互式世界模拟构建，且需先从 Hugging Face 准备好预训练权重。

en: Interactive, steerable video generation rather than fixed clips
Open pretrained weights hosted on Hugging Face (nyu-visionx/solaris)
zh: 可交互、可操控的视频生成，而非固定片段
支持多智能体世界场景
开放预训练权重托管于 Hugging Face（nyu-visionx/solaris）
来自 NYU VisionX 的研究成果
